name: 奥伦修斯
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_四_魔族之世.md:86
gear: 传奇（LVL 205）｜中｜祭司，不带兵器｜5档｜三川城书记官家的儿子，传奇不看家境定五档；他一辈子只带一支笔一枚主祭的印，不披甲，五档落在主祭整套法衣、骸银细链的肩披和身边战局一样的环光上（耶万的权柄在他手里是看得出一城往哪边动）。
who: Orentius, a human legend, the high priest of the temple of Yevan, god of war, in the Star-Crown holy city; a scribe's son from the Three Rivers city, nearly four hundred years old yet looking about fifty, unchanged since he reached legend: about 178 cm, lean and upright, a long serious face. Iron-grey hair cut short and combed back, a neat short grey beard. Deep-set steel-blue eyes that look first at a person's eyes and hold them. A pen callus and a smudge of ink on the second finger of the right hand. He carries no weapon, only a long plain pen and the high priest's heavy old-bronze seal on a chain at his chest, the seal cut with the sign of a sword resting in its scabbard. A grave, diligent, tired and not unkind air; temple cats follow him everywhere.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean man's face of about fifty, fine lines at the eyes and two deep lines between the brows, deep-set steel-blue steady eyes, straight iron-grey brows, a straight nose, a thin closed mouth in a neat short grey beard. Skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: about 178 cm, lean and upright: narrow shoulders, a straight back, long scholar's hands.
palette: ivory white and cold bone-silver, deep iron red, steel blue, ink black
casual: His daily vestments as high priest: a long ivory-white wool robe closed down the front with key-shaped clasps, fitted sleeves and a stiff ring-shaped standing collar; over it a long open sleeveless over-robe of deep iron-red wool reaching the ankles, its front edges embroidered in pale silver with the sign of a sword resting in its scabbard; a narrow belt with a small leather ink case; the heavy old-bronze seal hanging on a chain at his chest; soft dark shoes. In his right hand a long plain pen. He stands upright, a grave, measuring look.
private: Alone in the temple at night: the iron-red over-robe off, the ivory robe with the sleeves pushed up, a dark grey wool shawl over the shoulders, ink on the fingers, the seal still at his chest; a grey tabby cat held against his chest in the crook of one arm. A tired, quiet look.
battle: Standing in judgment over a field of war, in the war-priest's full vestments: the ivory robe and the deep iron-red over-robe, over them a short mantle of fine bone-silver mail laid across the shoulders like a stole, its clasp worked with the sheathed-sword sign; bone-silver bracers engraved with fine lines glowing cold white; no weapon and no armour beyond these. The heavy seal raised in his left hand shines with a cold white light, and around him hang wide translucent rings of white light marked with lines and arrows like the pieces and roads of a war table, showing where every host will move; the pen in his right hand is lifted as if to strike out one line.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: standing very upright and still, the feet together, the glowing seal raised in the left hand and the pen lifted in the right, rings of white light hanging around him at chest height; he carries no weapon, a grave, unblinking look.
formal: Sealing the judgment: the ivory robe and the iron-red over-robe brushed immaculate, a long bone-silver stole embroidered with the sheathed sword hanging to the hem, the seal held in both hands before his chest, the pen tucked at the belt. He stands very straight, a heavy, composed look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the steel-blue eyes looking straight into the viewer's eyes, steady and unreadable, the mouth closed. Pale dawn light from a high window on one side, the low warm glow of a lamp on the other. Foreground blur: the tip of a pen over a written page and the ear of a sleeping cat. He wears the iron-red over-robe.
